test_focus: FINAL VERIFICATION — Concierge wiring + 21 cortex tools live in /agent-chat-stream + /api/concierge/*
summary: End-to-end backend verification of the Concierge Engine wiring. The previous agent registered 21 cortex tools in TOOLS_SCHEMA, wired cortex_dispatch into _dispatch_tool, and added precheck_integrations into the agent-chat-stream endpoint. I created a new pytest file with 15 tests covering all 9 requested checks. ALL 15 TESTS PASSED. The critical SSE pause flow works: when the user types 'أبغى تطبيق موبايل iOS', the stream emits concierge_setup_required + 3 concierge_wizard_card events + done(paused_for_setup=true) — WITHOUT executing any tool call. Landing-page request correctly bypasses pause. Cortex tools (run_reviewer, extract_brand_dna, audit_a11y, design_database) dispatch correctly through cortex_tools.dispatch.

minor.recommendation: Add fallback heuristic or retry to design_database() so it never returns empty for valid briefs.

minor.issue: When validation fails for a fake token (validator returns valid=false), the endpoint returns 200 with saved=false. This is correct behavior but the response should ideally still include a 'reason' field from the validator so frontend can show an Arabic error message. Currently it just includes 'validation' object — works but UX could improve.
